Leetspeak Converter

Turn text into l33tsp34k with three intensity levels, from basic (A→4) to full symbol substitution.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your text.
  2. Pick a level: Basic, Medium or Full.
  3. Press Convert to leetspeak.
  4. Copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the three levels change?

Basic replaces A E I O S T; Medium adds L G Z B; Full replaces nearly every letter with symbols like # for H and |_| for U.

Can leetspeak be decoded back?

No — leetspeak is lossy (both L and I become 1), so decoding is not offered.

Will it work in usernames?

Most substitutions use common ASCII symbols so the result stays readable in games, chats and usernames.
